item.title: ACE Robotics' ACE-CaP-0 Has AI Agents Write Reusable Robot Code, Reporting 92.1% Success
item.description: ACE Robotics' ACE-CaP-0 has an AI agent write and freeze robot control code. The authors' own tests report 221 of 240 successful real-robot trials, or 92.1%.

item.title: Huawei Launches Xiaoyi AI Membership With Credit-Based Plans From 49 to 499 Yuan a Month
item.description: Huawei's new Xiaoyi AI membership turns paid features into credits: 49 yuan for 1,000, Pro at 199 yuan for 6,000 and Max at 499 yuan for 15,000 a month.

item.title: Tencent Releases Hy4 flash, a 224B Model at 2 Yuan per Million Output Tokens
item.description: Tencent's Hy4 flash has 224B total and 12B active parameters and costs 2 yuan per million output tokens. Its main results are on Tencent's internal WorkIndex benchmark.

item.title: DeepSeek Users Report Daily Caps and Shorter Inputs on App and Web, Unconfirmed by DeepSeek
item.description: Users report DeepSeek's free app and web chat now cap daily use, cut inputs to about 40,000 characters and drop stale long chats. DeepSeek has not confirmed.

item.description: Huawei Cloud says its CloudRobo-WM1.2 world action model will be open source, though no weights were listed at launch. It claims first place on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Pro 2.0.
